correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and 1<=k<=n-2, the two-level inclusion graph has Laplacian Schur complement the Johnson graph Laplacian, with a zero-sum edge source. Summing Green equations over Johnson distance balls yields strictly positive radial drops Delta_r; shell-ratio monotonicity verifies the nontrivial sign of each electrical edge current, including the formerly ambiguous z-in-S/i-in-A class. The explicitly displayed quadratic vertex potential w solves Lw=D sigma, so the signed sum of every edge column of Q=D^T(DD^T)^+D equals 2k+1-2k(k+1)/n. The source effective resistance Q_ee=1/(k+1)+(1-1/binom(n,k))/(n-k) gives the complementary P norm by |(I-Q)ee|=1-Qee. Complementation k -> n-k-1 covers remaining ranks; fixed-k and proportional-k asymptotics follow. Independently built rational grounded full-graph Laplacians reproduce norm, diagonal, and P norm for 10 (n,k) cases with 3<=n<=6; polynomial dual identity in the source was reconstructed by inspecting its coefficients rather than treating VERIFY_OK as proof. The infinite family follows from the Green/dual argument, not enumeration.
